Commentary.Commentary: Scotland bowlers were excellent to start off with and did exceedingly well towards the end but looked off-color in the middle overs. Bradley Wheal was the most impressive as he finished with figures of 10-1-43-3. Now then, 272 is what they need to remain unbeaten in the competition and more importantly, if they do it, they will be very close of making it through to the qualification. Will that happen? We'll find out soon. Join us for the chase in a while...

After winning the toss and electing to field, Scotland got off to the best start possible with a wicket in the first over of Stirling. However, Balbirnie and Porterfield steadied the ship before Wheal struck to remove the Irish skipper. Then Niall O'Brien joined forces with Balbirnie to stitch a massive 138-run stand with the former scoring a half ton and the latter scoring his second ton. Kevin O'Brien too came out and played a decent cameo and at that point it looked like the Irish would finish somewhere close to 300. But after the fall of the centurion the batting side lost its way completely.
An excellent comeback by Scotland towards the end, giving away just 30 runs in the last 5 overs and picking up 5 wickets, has seen them clawing their way back into the game.

OUT! RUN OUT! Excellent last over, just four and two wickets from it. A full ball on off, hit down towards long off. The batsmen complete one and then Rankin wants a second but his partner is not interested. He is halfway down the wicket and now has to turn and go back. MacLeod fires a throw to the keeper who collects it and whips the bails off. IRELAND END WITH 271 for 9!
Goes for the scoop but misses. Another dot.
Boyd Rankin walks out to the middle.

OUT! McCarthy holes out! They are falling like nine pins here. They were 241-4 and now have lost 4 wickets for 29 runs. A full toss, this should have been hit out of the park but Barry hits it straight to the man at long on. MacLeod there did not have to move an inch and he pouches an easy catch.
Very full on off, the batsman splices it over point for a brace.
Just 1 from the first two balls. Very good ball, full and on off, the batsman can't get underneath it as he drives it to covers for a run.
A full toss outside off, the batsman swings but misses it. A dot to begin the last over.
Full on off, driven down to long off for a run. A single to end the over, just five and a wicket from the penultimate one.
A full ball outside off, guided to point.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
On the pads, worked around the corner for a brace.
Barry McCarthy walks in at no. 9.

OUT! Timber! Another one bites the dust here. A slower ball on the leg stump. It completely deceives Singh as he tries the scoop. He misses to see his leg stump being shattered. A flurry of wickets towards the end for Ireland. Not good!
A yorker outside off, guided towards point for a run.
Fuller on off, driven towards mid off for a run. Just 6 from this over and 11 from the last two.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT! The dive has ensured he has made it in! A full ball on off, Singh drives it towards mid on. They complete one and go for the second. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The players appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and it shows the batsman to be safe.
A run out appeal has been taken upstairs at the non-striker's end. McBrine is the man in question, he seems to be in though.
Andy McBrine is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... and caught! Scotland fighting back here! Gary Wilson looks to be innovative as he tries to play the paddle to a full ball outside off. The ball takes the top edge and balloons towards square leg where Watt runs to his left and takes it easily to give Sharif his first. Three quick wickets and Ireland seem to be losing their way.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length around off, pushed towards cover for a run.
Safyaan Sharif is back on.
Shorter in length, guided to short third man. Just 5 from the over, a good one at this stage.
WIDE! Down the leg side and the umpire calls it a wide.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Fuller on off, eased to mid off for a run.

A yorker on the pads, Wilson tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg and they take a leg bye. The players make an appeal but the umpire is not interested. The umpire though has given it as a run and replays show there was an inside edge there. Good call!
On a length around off, pushed towards cover.
On the pads, worked around the corner for a run.
Gary Wilson strides out to the middle.

OUT! Sole has the last laugh! A very soft dismissal though. Chris lands it on a length around off, Kevin tries to force it through the off side but gets a thick outside edge which flies towards short third man where Wallace takes it reverse cup. O'Brien walks back dejected but an excellent cameo from him comes to an end. Two quick wickets for Scotland, can they now capitalize?
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Short and down the leg side. O'Brien helps it on its way, beating short fine leg for a boundary. 250 up for Ireland.

FOUR! But so close to being a catch. Another short ball on middle, it sits up to be hit. Kevin short arm jabs it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there makes good ground to his right and dives with his one hand stretched out but can't get to it as the ball goes for a one-bounce boundary.
On a length around off, pushed through covers for a run.
Slower ball on off, played to point.
On a length around off, guided down to third man for a run.
Chris Sole is back into the attack.
Simi Singh is the next man in.

OUT! Watt strikes on the final delivery of his spell to end a magnificent innings. Andy tries to be cute with a reverse sweep to a low full toss. He misses and the ball hits him on his toe. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger as the ball would have crashed into the stumps. Balbirnie walks off to a standing ovation and he deserves every bit of it.
Darts it full on leg stump, eased down to long on for a run.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a run.
FOUR! Balbirnie joins the party now! Watt fires it on leg stump, AB goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side.
A yorker outside off, jammed out to point for a run.
Very full on middle, O'Brien hits it in the gap at the mid-wicket region for a brace. It also brings the 50-run stand between the two.
Darts it on the stumps, kept out.
The batsman has lofted it over covers. One run added to the total.
He goes for it again but mistimes it. Fires it on middle, Kevin aims for the sightscreen but does not time it that well. It lands safe towards long off for a couple.
Flatter on off, punched to covers.
SIX! Kevin on the charge here! A short ball on middle, O'Brien has all the time in the world to rock back and send it sailing over the mid-wicket fence. He moves onto 30 in no time.
Flighted ball on middle, turning back in. O'Brien tries to work it with the spin but misses to get hit on the pads.
Michael Leask is back into the attack.
Quicker ball on the stumps, punched back to Watt.
Wide! Fired full down leg, Andy fails to sweep.
Gets across and wrists it towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.

100 up for Andy Balbirnie! What a knock from this man! He came in when his side was in trouble and has made sure he doesn't throw it away. Well played! Flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end. Punches the air, takes his helmet off and kisses the badge on it.
Eases a tossed up ball outside off towards long off to bring Andy back on strike.
FOUR! That's a horrible delivery! Fuller and fired down leg, Kevin O'Brien just helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.
Fuller length delivery outside off, O'Brien looks to drive it hard but gets an edge towards third man and he'll keep strike.
Fuller ball outside off, Balbirnie drives it in the cover region and moves on to 99.
Good length outside off, driven through cover for a single.
Fuller and on the pads, worked towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! That's gone fine! On a length and outside off, Kevin runs it down towards third man and gets a boundary. Deft!
On a length and in the nagging channel outside off, Kevin has a tame poke at it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Safyaan Sharif is back into the attack.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Good effort in the deep! Loopy ball outside off, Balbirnie sweeps it towards fine leg. Wheal in the deep hares across to his right and does well to pull the ball back in with a slide. They refer it upstairs and after a few looks, it's a clean stop feels the TV umpire. Two taken and Andy stays on 98.
Flighted ball around off, bunted back to Watt.
Goes back and punches it towards the cover fielder.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Balbirnie latches onto the cut shot. It beats the dive of the fielder in the deep. He's just one hit away from reaching a 100 now.
Floated delivery outside off, blocked into the ground.
Powerplay 3 signalled. One more fielder can now be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Fuller ball in the zone outside off, Kevin gets down on one knee to go over cover but misses it completely. They appeal for a caught behind but nothing from the umpire.

SIX! Nailed it! What a hit that is! Wheal once again drops it short but without much venom behind, Kevin goes deep in the crease and pummels it over square leg for a maximum all the way. 200 up for Ireland as well.
Very full on middle and off, jammed out back to the bowler.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short ball and sits up to be hit, Kevin O'Brien nails the pull in front of square on the leg side for a one-bounce boundary.
Calls for two and gets it! Pitched up delivery outside off, Kevin bends his back knee and drives it towards deep point for a double.
Good length ball outside off, defended off the front foot towards the cover fielder.
Around middle and off, turned towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Andy Balbirnie moves into the 90s now! Watt drops it short and serves it outside off, the batter cuts it hard through point and finds the fence.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up delivery, dipping in on middle, Andy gets down and takes it on the full. Sweeps well but finds the man at short fine leg.
On middle and leg, tucked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Drops it short outside off, slapped off the back foot towards cover.
Mark Watt is back into the attack.
Fuller ball outside off, defended off the front foot towards the cover fielder.
Cuts it past the man this time and picks up a single.
Shortish and outside off, steered towards backward point.
Hangs back and stabs it out.
Back of a length ball on middle, punched towards mid-wicket.
Kevin O'Brien is the new man in.

OUT! Run out! Scotland have got the breakthrough here. They rejoice and the happiness on their faces sums it up. Wheal drops it on a length around middle, O'Brien taps it towards mid-wicket and sets off. He stops a bit and then again starts to run. Craig Wallace collects the ball and takes his time before scoring a direct hit at the bowler's end. The Irish keeper had already given up. The good-looking 138-run stand comes to an end. Is this the opening Scotland were looking for?
Bradley Wheal is back on. Scotland need a breakthrough here and they would bank on this man to provide it.
Slower and shorter in length outside off, Andy dances down the track and defends it back to the bowler.
Tries to be cheeky here! Fires it full outside off does Leask, Balbirnie gets down to play the reverse sweep but fails to get any wood on it.
Turning in from a length outside off, kept out back to the bowler.
Drops it short and outside off, punched past the cover fielder for a single.
FOUR! Well swept! Tossed up delivery outside off, O'Brien gets down and sweeps it neatly through backward square leg for a boundary.
Flatter ball outside off, pushed into the cover region for a single.
Michael Leask is back.
Back of a length on off, O'Brien tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On the pads, looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On a length around off, guided down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Just out of the reach! Short and wide again. Balbirnie guides it uppishly but away from the diving fielder at point and into the fence. He moves onto 83.
Shorter in length on off, guided to point.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
Swept behind square on the leg side for a single by Balbirnie.
Floated delivery on off, drilled towards long off for one.
FOUR! Miscued but no harm done! Tossed up delivery outside off, Niall O'Brien dances down the track and looks to go over extra cover. Doesn't get it off the middle but has enough to find the fence.
Andy gets to the other end by nudging it towards wide mid on.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, flicked towards the same region again.
Darted in on the pads, flicked towards mid on.
On a length and outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Helped away! Shortish ball down the leg side, all Niall O'Brien had to do was help it away. And he does so with ease. Fetches an easy boundary towards fine leg.
Length delivery on middle and off, pulled towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and angling down leg, pulled on the bounce towards fine leg for a single.
Good length on the stumps, defended off the back foot.
Wide! Short ball down the leg side, O'Brien leaves it alone.
Floats it up on middle, eased to mid on.

FOUR! Poor, very poor from the fielder Leask there. Balbirnie drives the full ball towards long off. The fielder comes running towards the ball but gets a bad bounce. He fails to stop it and the ball goes through his legs and into the fence. The bowler is not happy and rightly so as it was a poor effort. He should have had his body behind.
Fires it on the stumps, defended.
Works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Floats it up on off, driven through mid on to change strike.
Mark Watt is back on.
Fuller on middle, driven through mid on for a run. 25 runs from the last two overs.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the pads, worked around the corner for a brace.
FOUR! 18th ODI fifty for Niall O'Brien and the 100-run stand comes up in style. Full ball on middle, O'Brien drives it straight back past the bowler and the ball races away.
Shorter in length outside off, guided through backward point for a run.

FOUR! Runs are starting to flow here. This though wasn't in convincing fashion but Ireland won't mind. 17 from the last 7 balls. Short ball on middle, Balbirnie goes for the pull shot but gets a top edge over the keeper's head and into the fence.
A single to end the over! 13 runs from it. Eases the floated ball on middle, through mid on for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Tosses it up on off, driven down to long on for a run.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is turning out to be an expensive over. The bowler isn't learning here, he once again darts it on the leg stump. Too easy for Niall as he sweeps it over the short fine leg fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! Nicely done! Once again down the leg side. O'Brien goes down on one knee and paddles it fine past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
On the stumps, worked around the corner for a run.
Fires it down the leg side. The batsman fails to connect with the sweep and the keeper also fails to collect it. The ball hits his pads and goes towards short fine leg for a bye. It is also a wide.
Extra bounce! Digs in a length ball outside off, Balbirnie tries slashing it through the line but is undone by the extra bounce.
Gets a fuller ball on the pads, worked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Beaten again! Fuller ball, angling away on off, Niall dances down the track to slog it across the line but there is no pace on it and he gets foxed by it.
Shorter in length outside off, cut without any timing towards point.
Slants it away on a length outside off, Niall O'Brien looks to cut but it's too close to do that. Gets beaten.
Fuller ball, wider outside off, Balbirnie goes hard as he looks to drive it away. Gets an edge which flies past the backward point region for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, milked down to long on for a single.
On the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Makes a bit of room and drives it through cover for a single.
Niall lunges forward and pats it towards short cover for a brisk single.
Andy flicks it with the turn through square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, blocked into the ground.
Calum MacLeod is brought on to bowl.
Drifting on the pads, easy pickings for O'Brien as he clips it towards fine leg. He runs the first one hard, hesitates for the second but they complete it easily in the end.
Fuller and on the pads, worked straight to Coetzer at mid-wicket.
Cutter, hurled outside off, slapped off the edge which goes fine down to third man for a single.
Cuts a length ball through point for a single.
Fullish on middle, driven back down the wicket.

FOUR! Edged and it flies through the vacant slip cordon! Fuller delivery, angling away outside off, Niall O'Brien goes hard at it. Gets a thick edge which flies through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary towards third man.
Safyaan Sharif is back on.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched through cover for a single.
Angling in on middle, Niall O'Brien tries flicking it across the line but misses and gets hit on the pads. They appeal but it was sliding down leg.
Slower length ball outside off, blocked solidly.
On the stumps, driven towards mid on where the fielder fumbles and concedes a single.
Goes around the wicket and hurls it on a length outside off, dabbed with an angled bat towards third man for one.
Fuller in length and drifting on the pads, worked away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flattish ball outside off, cut through point for a single to end the over.
Presses ahead to a tossed up ball and pushes it into the off side.
Fuller and on middle and leg, driven towards long on for a single.
The Irish batsmen are using the sweep shot to good affect. This time it's Balbirnie who sweeps it through backward square leg to rotate strike.
Tossed up delivery outside off, swept through mid-wicket for a single.
Flattish delivery on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven through cover for a couple of runs.
Too full from around the wicket, it's on off, Niall looks to drive but can't get away with the shot. Mistimes it back to the bowler.
Very full on the stumps, driven past the bowler towards mid on for one more. 100 up for Ireland!
On the pads, helped towards fine leg for another single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, tucked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller and angling in on middle, wristed towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Richard Berrington into the bowling attack now.
Slower ball outside off, Niall leans forward and pats it away.
Loops it up outside off, worked away off the front foot.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up ball well outside off, the Irish keeper gets down and sweeps it over backward square leg for a boundary. This also bring up the 50-run stand between the duo.
Gets down and across to sweep it towards backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, blocked into the ground.
Short ball outside off, O'Brien smashes it in the air but through the gap at cover for a single.
Flighted ball outside off, Niall with an open bat face pushes it through cover-point for a single.
Eases it down to long off and gets to the other end.
Balbirnie flicks this tossed up delivery towards mid-wicket where the fielder dives to stop it.
On the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side but can't beat the fielder there.
Darted in on the stumps, AB keeps it out off the front foot.
Very full on middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Leans ahead and strokes it straight to mid off. Just a single from the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
Gets behind the line and defends it down again.
Lunges forward and blocks.

6th ODI fifty for Andy Balbirnie. He has done well to get to it. Now he needs to convert it since he has gotten his eye in. Drives the full ball through cover to reach to the milestone. Raises the bat towards the dressing room.
Drops it short and outside off, slapped through cover-point for a couple.

Andy is safe! Quicker delivery on the pads, nudged towards mid-wicket and the batsmen set off. The fielder picks it up and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. It's taken upstairs and replays find Balbirnie well in.
Direct hit at the bowler's end has been taken upstairs but the batsman seems to be home.
Flatter ball outside off, a mistimed punch towards cover.
Floated delivery around off, once again smothered off the front foot.
Tosses it up there on off, blocked gently off the front foot.
Very full on the stumps, swept neatly through backward square leg for a brace.
No run.
Flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fires it on middle, kept out.
Gives it air on middle, AB once again goes for the sweep but is beaten by the bounce.
FOUR! The sweep shot works on the third time of asking and it gets him a boundary too. Leask floats it up outside off, Balbirnie goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side.
Tosses it up on middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Fires it on middle, blocked.
On the shorter side and on the pads, Niall flicks it through square leg for a run.
Quicker but on the shorter side, punched through covers for a run.
Flatter on middle, kept out.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a run.
Mark Watt is back on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Very full on off, driven through covers to change strike.
Nudges it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.

A huge shout but not given! Gives it air on off and gets it to turn back in. Balbirnie goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The impact and the height could be an issue there.
Flatter on off, pushed through covers for a run.
Loopy ball on off, O'Brien prods forward and keeps it out.
DRINKS!
Edge but a run! On a length around off, O'Brien pushes at it but gets an outside edge which flies down to third man for a run.
Shortish on off, pulled through square leg to change strike.

Another good stop! The ground fielding of the Scotland team has been really good. Shorter in length outside off, AB punches it towards point where Richie Berrington dives to his right and makes an excellent stop.
On a length around off, defended.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
On the pads, worked to square leg.
Flighted ball on middle, Balbirnie goes for the sweep but the ball hits his arm and falls beside the pitch.
Floats it up on off, eased to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A drag down on leg stump, Balbirinie pulls it hard towards short fine leg. The fielder there saves three runs as he dives to his left and stops it.
Tosses it up on off, the batsman lunges forward and defends it.
Shorter on off and turning into the batsman. Andy works it through backward square leg for a couple.
Michael Leask is into the attack now.
Shorter in length on off, guided down to third man for a run.
Good ball! Bends his back on this one and lands it on a length around off, it shoots off the surface. AB does really well to pull his bat out of the shot.
Another bouncer but this one too bounces way above the batsman's head and the umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Excellent shot! He is now looking really good out there! On the shorter side and width on offer outside off. Balbirnie camps back and punches it through cover-point and the ball races away.
Back of a length on off, defended.
On the pads, worked around the corner for a brace.

In the air... but on the bounce! A well-directed short ball. Niall takes on the challenge of pulling it but gets a top edge which flies towards the fine leg fielder. He comes running in but collects it on the bounce. A run taken.
Shorter in length on off, eased to covers.
On a length on off, pushes it to covers.
Goes back to bowling a length outside off, left alone.
WIDE! Short ball which bounces way above the batsman's head and the umpire signals a wide.
Just behind a length on off, AB blocks it off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
FOUR! Poor ball and the bowler pays the price! Short and outside off, Balbirnie rocks back and punches it nicely through cover-point for the second boundary in the last three balls.
On a length around off, kept out.
FOUR! Crashed! Full and wide outside off, a hit-me ball. Niall obliges and hits it through covers for a boundary.
The batsman has stood up on his toes to play that one.
On a length around off, left alone.
An ambitious appeal! Bowls it on the pads, O'Brien misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head as the ball is pitching outside leg.
Fuller on off, eased towards mid off for a run.
Chris Sole is back into the attack.
On the pads, worked to mid-wicket. End of a wicket maiden for Wheal.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Niall O'Brien is the next batsman.

OUT! Chopped on! Wheal gets his second, one would wonder why was he even taken out of the attack? He has been splendid today, Bradley. Comes running in and lands it on a length around off, lovely seam position too and gets it to shape back in a touch as well. Porterfield with no feet movement, tries to push it through the off side but he does not account for the inswing and that proves to be his undoing. The ball takes the inside edge and crashes into the off stump. A timely wicket for Scotland as this partnership was starting to build. The drop catch has not cost them a lot as Porterfield walks back cheaply.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
On a length around off, pushed to covers.
The batsman gets a leading edge on that one.

NOT OUT! The poor throw does save Andy here! Porterfield cuts the short ball towards cover. He thinks he has beaten the fielder in the ring and sets off for a run. Wheal, though dives full stretch to his right and makes a very good stop. Seeing that the batsmen hesitate but then go for the run. Wheal gets up and fires a poor throw at the keeper's end who collects it above his head and whips the bails off as Andy dives in an attempt to make it in. The umpire goes upstairs and replays show that the dive and the wild throw has saved him. Another chance missed, not good this from Scotland.
Run out appeal! Balbirnie is the man in question at the striker's end. The umpires have taken it upstairs but the poor throw might have saved him.
FOUR! The drop has already cost them four! Short and wide outside off, Porterfield pounces onto it and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Tosses it up on off, driven down to long on for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flatter on off, pushed to covers.
Spinner for the first time today! Mark Watt is into the attack.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.

Has that carried? Excellent delivery. Wheal almost strikes in the first over of his second spell. He bowls it on a length around off, it shapes away a touch. Porterfield pokes at it and gets an outside edge which goes low towards Leask at first slip. It seems to have carried to him as he gets two hands to it but can't hang on. That should have been taken. How costly will this prove? Only time will tell.
Once again attacks the pads, hoping for the batsman to fall over as he tries to flick. AB however, puts bat to it and works it around the corner for a run.
Bowls the sucker ball outside off, the batsman though does not go after it and leaves it.
Three dots to start his second spell! On a length around off, Balbirnie blocks it.
On a length around off, defended.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
Bradley Wheal is back into the attack.
Shorter on the body of the batsman, AB mistimes his pull towards fine leg for a run.

FOUR LEG BYES! Poor by the bowler, he has been bowling too straight and this time he bowls it down the leg side. Balbirnie tries to flick but misses. The ball though brushes the pads and races down to the fine leg fence.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on middle, Andy flicks it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Angles it into the batsman, worked to mid-wicket.
Andy is timing the ball well here! He hits this one off the middle but straight to the fielder at mid off.
Fullish on off, driven towards the cover fielder for a run.
Tries to surprise the batsman with a short one but does not get it to bounce a lot. William pulls it through backward square leg for a run. The partnership between the two moves onto 31.
Ahead of a length on middle, crisply driven back to the bowler.
Attacks the stumps on middle, pushed to mid on.
Fuller on off, not very full. Andy times it nicely through covers for three.
Lands it on a length outside off, Balbirnie makes a leave.
Good stop! Sharif bowls it on the pads, the batsman works it towards square leg. Wheal there dives to his right and saves at least two for his side.
Short of a length ball outside off, slapped towards cover where the fielder dives all over the ball and concedes a single.
Wide! He'll have to bowl an extra delivery this time. Sprays it too wide outside off and the umpire stretches both his arms.
Similar length and line, almost on the tramline but the umpire doesn't call it a wide.
Back of a length, this time a bit wider outside off, Balbirnie rises on his toes to cut it through the line but gets a bottom edge which goes on a couple of bounces to the keeper.
On a length outside off, Balbirnie lifts his bat to make a leave.
Good length delivery on leg, clipped behind square on the leg side for a comfortable single.
Wide! Another one on a shorter length but this time down the leg side, Porterfield looks to help it with a pull but fails to connect. It's rightly called as a wide.
Begins his spell with a short ball, angling in on middle and leg, Andy pulls it towards fine leg and scampers through for a single.
Christopher Sole is brought into the attack.
On middle and leg, tucked off the back foot towards the man at mid-wicket. Scotland have been disciplined this morning.
Sharif delivers it a bit fuller on off, Porterfield presses forward and offers a water-tight defense.
Keeps it closer to the off stump this time, the Irish skipper gets behind the line and presents a straight bat.
Tempting line, in the corridor outside off, WP is happy to leave it unharmed.

Gets a fuller delivery outside off, Andy leans into it and effortlessly times the drive through cover. The outfield isn't that quick and hence it allows the man from cover to chase it down. By the time he mops it up, three runs are taken.
On a length and moving away from off, Balbirnie just punches it through the line. It beats the dive of the fielder at point and the batsmen take two.
Curling back in on middle and leg, tapped off the back foot towards the leg side to end the over with a dot.
Angles it away on a fuller length outside off, William is happy to shoulder his arms to it.

SIX! Top edge but goes fine! Wheal digs in a short ball on middle and leg, Porterfield looks to take on the pull. Isn't in any control and gets a big top edge. Much to his delight, it flies over the keeper and into the fine leg fence for a maximum. First of the match.
Drifting in on the pads, Andy walks across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Marginally fuller, just around off, Balbirnie is solid in defense.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped away with an angled bat towards point.
A yorker on off, Porterfield keeps it out.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Back of a length on off, the batsman taps it towards cover for a run.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Good length outside off, the batsman does not fiddle with it.
Another delivery on the pads to William. He works it around the corner for a run. He moves onto three and all the three runs are on the leg side.

FOUR! First of the game! Excellent shot! Fuller on off, Balbirnie lunges into it and drives it through mid off. The ball races through and goes to the fence. Good end to the over, 6 runs from this one.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Tries to bowl the similar delivery to the last ball. This time though it is a little too straight. Balbirnie works it through mid on and the batsmen run two.

Howzaaat? Not out is the answer to that question. But this looked mighty, mighty close. Wheal bowls it fuller on off, shaping in a touch. Balbirnie plants his front foot way too across as he tries to flick. He almost looses his balance and misses the ball. It hits him on his front pad and the players appeal but the umpire after a thought shakes his head. He might have felt it must be sliding down but had there been a review, Scotland might have gone for it.
Fuller on off, eased to mid off.
Back of a length on off, kept out. Another good over comes to an end. Good start by Scotland.
Lovely bowling! Sharif lands it on a length around off, makes good use of the angle as he slants it away from the batsman. Porterfield tries to keep it out but gets beaten.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. One run added to the total.
BEATEN! Beauty! On a length around off, it first angles into the batsman and then leaves him after pitching. He hangs his bat out but luckily for him it just beats the outside edge.
Wide outside off, left alone.
On the pads, worked through square leg for a run.
Also, Safyaan Sharif to bowl from the other end.
Andy Balbirnie is the new man in.

OUT! Wheal strikes in his first over! Excellent start for Scotland after winning the toss and opting to bowl. An early breakthrough and it is a big one of Stirling. Wheal once again bowls it on a tight line around off and also pitches it on a length. It shapes in a touch this time. Stirling tries to defend but the ball takes the inside edge, hits him on his thigh and lobs up in the air. The bowler, in his followthrough dives forward and takes a very good catch inches above the ground. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Another failure for Stirling as he walks back without troubling the scorers much. End of a terrific first over, just a run and a wicket from it.
Just ahead of a length on off, swings away a touch. Paul strokes it on the up towards mid off. He opts against a single.
Tight line once again! On off, no movement this time. Stirling is solid in defense.
A little seam movement there! Length ball around off, shapes away a touch. Stirling tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards square leg.
Off the mark is William and so is his team. Errs in line and bowls it on the pads. Porterfield works it through backward square leg for a run.
Right on the money! On a length and bowled on the off pole. A good one first up. Porterfield lunges forward and pushes it to mid off.

We are done and dusted with the national anthems and now the Scotland players and the umpires make their way out to the middle. William Porterfield and Paul Stirling will open the batting for the Irish. Whereas, Bradley Wheal will open the bowling for Scotland. We have overcast conditions here and the seamer will look to make good use of it. He has two slips in place. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Ian Bishop says the boundary dimensions are same on both the sides. Informs it is a used pitch and the foot marks might provide some assistance for the spinners. Ends by saying the seamers might also get something with the new ball as the conditions are a bit overcast.
Ireland (Playing XI) - William Porterfield(c), Paul Stirling, Andrew Balbirnie, Simi Singh, Niall O Brien(w), Kevin O Brien, Gary Wilson, Andy McBrine, Barry McCarthy, Boyd Rankin, Tim Murtagh.
Scotland (Playing XI) - Matthew Cross(w), Kyle Coetzer(c), Calum MacLeod, Richie Berrington, George Munsey, Craig Wallace, Michael Leask, Safyaan Sharif, Mark Watt, Chris Sole, Bradley Wheal.
Ireland skipper, William Porterfield, says he was not sure about what he wanted to do. Admits they too are high on confidence and are up for this game. Informs Simi Singh replaces Ed Joyce.

Scotland skipper, Kyle Coetzer, says there is a bit of cloud cover around and it might assist their seamers. Mentions it is their first game here but they don't want to use that as an excuse and just want to play some good cricket. Admits they are high on confidence and they will look to extend their winning momentum. Informs they are unchanged from the last game.
TOSS - Scotland win the toss and opt to field.

Scotland, on the other hand, are yet to taste a defeat in this competition. They are flourishing in all three departments and Coetzer will hope for the same to continue. Let us hope we get to witness a cracking encounter between the two. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.

Hello and welcome to the fourth game of the Super Six Stage. It is a clash between Ireland and Scotland in Harare. A do-or-die game for the Irish if they are to stay alive in the series. Their batting has been their major concern and it is high time they resurrect it.
